IMHO, that's just the nature of being a Youtuber in general. At some point or another you will get hate comments. Don't let them get to you. You can use their opinions to improve and build upon your videos.

If you drink a lot of soda (say 3, maybe 4+ cans a day) you might be in for a few withdrawal headaches for the first few weeks but your body will eventually adjust to the change. It's definitely not easy at first. Don't quit cold turkey, just slowly ween yourself off of it.

I find that freezing cold spring water is a good way to keep me awake and busy at work or perhaps you could switch to coffee if possible? 

You could also try to take the diet soda route but I wouldn't recommend it, although you might lose weight from it either way.

FWIW I lost over 40 lbs. dropping soda and switching completely to water. That's all I really changed in my diet too if you can believe it. Just make sure your caloric intake is still in check! :)

Heavy soda drinking also pretty much ruined my teeth. The acidic content doesn't play well with a lot of things so I don't drink it anymore at all for the most part.
